newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares end lower on SEBI's directions.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares end lower on SEBI's directions.

text.p: Delhi shares ended lower on Friday as operators covered short positions on reports that the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) had asked stock exchanges to submit their short positions daily, brokers said.
The Delhi bourse'e benchmark index ended 0.36 point lower at 648.99.
"There were very few participants in the market throughout the session which was also reflected in the index," Amit Sethi of brokers Vashisht securities said.
Earlier, Bharat Bhushan of stock brokers Nu Era Equity said SEBI's directive to stock exchanges to ask brokers to submit their short sale positions each down had slowed selling pressure.
State Bank of India ended 1.75 rupees higher at 219.05.
Larsen and Toubro rose 3.10 rupees to 214.20.
